description.value: Like many atraxids, you have spent a great deal of time building and repairing starships. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Recall Knowledge] about starships using Crafting instead of Piloting. When you critically fail a Crafting check to Recall Knowledge about starships, you get a failure instead.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
